target_boundary: S02/S03 are privileged raw preparation/target packaging before participant release; necessarily access withheld counts but may not fit/select scientific methods or expose derivatives. S13/S14 are the only assessment-stage target/derived-ledger consumers after global barrier. Distinct role capabilities, not a false claim acquisition never saw targets.

preconditions_not_extra_producer_stages.meaning: Different complete scientific/API design acceptance; not scientific authority.
Complete implementation, static and tiny inert engineering controls, different whole-source review; no authentic or numerical qualification inferred.
Separately selected current authentic qualification/study authority, rights, host containment and finite original budgets. Conditional authority alone does not satisfy any empirical checkpoint.

incomplete_branch: S10/S11/S12 failure may terminate at metadata-only S16 disposition. Post-barrier uncertainty/report failure preserves earlier independently valid full-panel scores but not complete inference claims.
